papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 23 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
papers.summary: AdaExploreBench evaluates whether LLM agents can actively discover hidden environmental rules and adapt to unannounced changes, revealing that current models struggle to seek relevant evidence and detect stale knowledge.

papers.summary: OpenVLHarness improves multimodal reasoning by integrating persistent memory, heterogeneous tool interfaces, and iterative evidence composition across 22 benchmarks.

papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 22 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
papers.summary: BlenderWorld is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal language models on realistic 3D creation tasks using rendered outputs and binary rubrics, revealing significant gaps in spatial coherence.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.
